pages:
The falls freeze from the top down.
Up here is where it starts.
battle_lost: The ice cracked first. Then me.
battle_won:
Cold hands, slow team.
Warm up and come back.
after:
Hop down the ledge. The shelf
below takes you back.

pages: A tiny Kilu carved in ice.

Someone gave it a scarf
made of real wool.

r9_fscp_lookout.name: Kesia
r9_fscp_lookout._name_note: Renamed from Tove: Tove is already the Switchbacks shelf skier.
pages:
You came up through the falls?
Then you earned the view.
battle_lost: Fair. The view is yours too now.
battle_won:
Catch your breath. The air's thin,
and so was your team.
after:
The ledge drops you right
into camp.

pages:
A tiny flag in the ice.
It says: FIRST UP.

Under it, smaller:
SECOND UP.

The spire has a cellar. Nobody
asks what's in it. You did.
battle_lost:
All right. It's mostly rocks.
And me.
battle_won:
Curiosity's a long climb down.
Mind the steps.
after:
Hop down the ledge.
The camp is right there.

pages:
A row of tiny boots, smallest
to biggest. The last pair is gone.

Someone is still out there,
climbing.

The river left. The spring stayed.
So did I.
battle_lost:
You found the water and a fight.
Lucky day.
battle_won:
The stick pointed at you.
It was right, too.
after: The ledge drops you by the nook.

pages:
A tin cup on a nail.
Scratched on it: BACK SOON.
The dust says otherwise.

The herd naps up here. Keep it
down. Or battle me loudly.
battle_lost:
Loud and good.
The herd didn't even wake.
battle_won:
Shh. You lost, and they slept
through it. Best kind of loss.
after: Hop off the ledge into the yard.

pages: A cowbell with nothing inside to ring.

Someone wanted the herd quiet.
It worked.

You hear that? No? Good.
I tuned it out.
battle_won:
Bit flat, that one.
Tune up and try again.
after: The ledge drops you in the grass.

pages:
A frayed rope goes up into the
dark. You give it a tug.
Far away, something goes bong.

This crack runs all the way down
to the old river. I dug it. Mostly.
battle_lost: Fair. You dig a good fight.
battle_won:
Dug yourself a hole there.
I'd know.
after: Drop off the ledge to the lane.

pages: A pile of bent spoons.

Every one of them tried. Every
one lost to the rock.
